decks.notes: This deck focuses on using fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal to power out disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Elite Spellbinder early in the game. It aims to control the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Palace Jailer while applying pressure with creatures like Anointed Peacekeeper and White Plume Adventurer. The inclusion of Solitude provides additional removal options, giving the deck a versatile toolkit to deal with a variety of threats. Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire and Karakas provide protection for key creatures, allowing for a strong and resilient aggro strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to control and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage. It utilizes a combination of counterspells (Force of Will), removal spells (Swords to Plowshares, Prismatic Ending), and card selection/draw spells (Ponder, Brainstorm, Expressive Iteration) to control the board and ensure the player has the necessary answers. The inclusion of Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes adds a unique win condition and utility to the deck. Additionally, the deck has access to powerful cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Endurance to further control the board.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing aggressive creatures and utilizing powerful spells early on. By using mana acceleration and disruptive cards like Chancellor of the Annex and Anointed Peacekeeper, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and apply pressure on the opponent. Additionally, cards like Palace Jailer and Solitude provide removal options to deal with threats, while the mix of high-value creatures like Archon of Emeria and White Plume Adventurer contribute to the overall synergy and efficiency of the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents through a combination of efficient creatures and countermagic. Utilizing cards like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to apply pressure while keeping opponents off balance with cards like Daze and Force of Will. Expressive Iteration and Brainstorm help dig for key pieces while Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal options. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's aggressive game plan, with cards like Wasteland and Mishra's Bauble added for extra utility.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a strong board presence of artifact creatures and utilize cards like Urza's Saga, Emry, and Thoughtcast to draw cards and generate mana advantage. Cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will provide disruption to opponents, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble help to trigger artifact synergies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive artifact creatures and powerful artifacts like Shadowspear for a fast and efficient win.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures to put pressure on the opponent while disrupting their strategies with cards like Punishing Fire and Collector Ouphe. Green Sun's Zenith and Sylvan Library help to tutor for key creatures and maintain card advantage. The deck also leverages the power of lands like Wasteland and Knight of the Reliquary to control the board and limit the opponent's resources. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and outmaneuver the opponent with its versatile creature lineup and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on cheating powerful creatures like Emrakul and Griselbrand into play quickly using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with these huge threats before they have a chance to respond. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to win the game quickly and decisively through its explosive plays and efficient use of mana resources.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while using countermagic and removal spells to control the game and protect our threats. By combining tempo plays with efficient creatures and disruption, this UR Aggro deck aims to quickly apply pressure to the opponent and maintain control of the game through card advantage and powerful spells. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Expressive Iteration adds additional card advantage and threats to the deck, making it a versatile and competitive choice for Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting your opponent with cards like Daze and Force of Will. It utilizes cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat for removal and burn, and also has efficient card draw with cards like Ponder and Brainstorm. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent early while controlling the board with counterspells and removal spells, ultimately aiming to deal enough damage to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will, while also utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic to provide additional value and threats. It aims to stabilize the board and gain incremental advantages with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Baleful Strix helps to maintain card advantage and protect against opposing strategies. By efficiently managing resources and card advantage, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent to secure victory.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to quickly assemble the necessary cards to cast Doomsday, stack the top of the library in a specific order, and win the game by drawing and playing Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the same turn. The deck includes various card draw and discard spells to help find and protect the combo pieces, as well as mana acceleration in the form of Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Lion's Eye Diamond to facilitate casting Doomsday as early as possible.

The main concept of this deck is to be aggressive with efficient threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Daze, Force of Will, and Pyroblast. The deck aims to control the board with disruptive spells and land destruction like Wasteland while keeping up the pressure with cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Expressive Iteration. The deck also utilizes cantrip spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary cards to keep the tempo up and overwhelm the opponent quickly.

This Legacy UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with cards like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. By playing aggressively and utilizing tempo plays, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan. The key strategy is to apply constant pressure while maintaining control of the game through disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and fast mana acceleration to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Spirit of the Labyrinth while utilizing equipment like Umezawa's Jitte and Kaldra Compleat to increase the effectiveness of its creatures. By combining efficient creatures with disruptive elements, the deck aims to overpower the opponent and control the pace of the game, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using artifacts like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal, while utilizing cards such as Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist to generate tokens and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will, while utilizing Urza's Saga to tutor for essential artifacts such as Shadowspear and Pithing Needle. The deck also seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Otawara, Soaring City and Kappa Cannoneer.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void, while quickly overwhelming them with powerful creatures like Legion Warboss, Laelia, the Blade Reforged, and Goblin Rabblemaster. The deck also utilizes cards like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing for removal and reach, and uses fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Simian Spirit Guide to deploy threats ahead of schedule. The deck aims to lock down the game early and close it out with aggressive plays.
